material_concerns.concern: Refusal is expressed as "without inventing numbers" and a truthful rewrite, not an explicit cannot/refuse sentence. This semantically satisfies the boundary but a wording-based strict grader could disagree.
First question has two follow-up clauses within one episode. Treated as one case question, not a three-question questionnaire.
Senior-level relevance is supported by ambiguous stakeholder framing and decision impact; analyst discipline is assumed data/business and labeled as an assumption.
Synthetic fixture supports fidelity checks but cannot establish practical coaching efficacy on real interviews.

limitations: Single model-teacher review; no independent human labels or calibrated accuracy estimate.
No assertion requires live side effects; no actual learner transfer, hiring fairness, clinical correctness, or downstream outcome is demonstrated by a good response.
All assertions met under semantic review is not a release gate or approval; execution completion is recorded separately and limited to response presence.
